description: Source file defining functions for logging cookie-related events in the net namespace, including cookie creation, deletion, rejection, and preservation, with sensitive data handling.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterConstructorParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with a boolean indicating if a persistent store is used.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieAdded
methods.description: Logs details of a cookie when added, including name, value, domain, path, security, priority, same-site, persistence, and party status.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieDeleted
methods.description: Logs details when a cookie is deleted, including name, value, domain, path, persistence, and cause.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieRejectedSecure
methods.description: Logs details when a secure cookie is rejected, including old and new cookie values and paths.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookieRejectedHttponly
methods.description: Logs details when an HttpOnly cookie is rejected, including old and new cookie values and paths.

methods.name: NetLogCookieMonsterCookiePreservedSkippedSecure
methods.description: Logs details when a secure cookie is skipped and preserved, including cookie domain, path, preserved value, and discarded value.
